coverage.note: Authored synthetic correspondence. Not a live mailbox or a complete account export.

messages.subject: Glass Kite — GL-42 equipment loan
messages.body: Production has budget approval for the Glass Kite loan, GL-42: recorder R8 for dialogue and LED lighting kit L2 for the night exterior. Budget approval is from me as producer; the co-op’s release authority belongs to Noor. The two units appear as separate lines even though they share one booking number.

messages.subject: Glass Kite — GL-42 equipment loan
messages.body: I will collect recorder R8 for Glass Kite on 9 October 2026 at 17:00 PDT (America/Los_Angeles, UTC−07:00). I will collect LED lighting kit L2 at the same 9 October 2026 17:00 PDT appointment. I am handling both collections under GL-42, rather than asking the actors to transport equipment.

messages.subject: GL-42 condition sheet
messages.body: I will send you the completed GL-42 condition sheet by 7 October 2026 at 12:00 PDT (America/Los_Angeles, UTC−07:00). It combines the recorder and lighting photographs from our bench inspection. Both units stayed at the co-op after that inspection.

messages.subject: Glass Kite — GL-42 equipment loan
messages.body: Release approved for GL-42: recorder R8 and LED lighting kit L2, collection 9 October 2026 at 17:00 PDT (America/Los_Angeles, UTC−07:00). I have entered both lines in the co-op booking record. The bench inspection did not transfer custody.

messages.subject: GL-42 condition sheet
messages.body: I have sent you the completed GL-42 condition sheet as GL42-condition.pdf. It includes the recorder’s scratched battery door and the missing rubber foot on one LED stand. All required photographs and my signature are in this final copy.

messages.subject: Glass Kite — GL-42 equipment loan
messages.body: The location owner withdrew the night exterior, and the dialogue is moving off-camera. Please cancel both the recorder collection and the LED lighting kit collection under GL-42. There is no replacement equipment order approved for this version of the shoot.

messages.subject: Glass Kite — GL-42 equipment loan
messages.body: I have cancelled my recorder collection and my LED lighting kit collection under GL-42. Neither pickup will happen. The condition sheet already sent can remain in the co-op’s inspection record; cancelling the collections does not retract that delivery.

messages.subject: GL-42 damage deposit
messages.body: I am responsible for refunding your $240 GL-42 damage deposit following the cancellation. I have accepted the refund request, but I do not have a settlement date to give you. This is cash paid by you, not the insured replacement value of the equipment.

messages.subject: Glass Kite — GL-42 equipment loan
messages.body: A sound-only insert is back in the cut. Could we restore the recorder R8 collection for 12 October 2026 at 10:00 PDT (America/Los_Angeles, UTC−07:00)? The insert uses the existing daylight, so I am not requesting the LED lighting kit. I need Noor’s release approval as well as your agreement.

messages.subject: Glass Kite — GL-42 equipment loan
messages.body: I approve reopening GL-42 for the recorder R8 collection only, on 12 October 2026 at 10:00 PDT (America/Los_Angeles, UTC−07:00). The LED lighting kit is excluded from this release. The new insurance rider must cover the recorder alone; the broad lighting-and-sound description from the first booking is not suitable.

messages.subject: Glass Kite — GL-42 equipment loan
messages.body: Accepted. I will collect recorder R8 on 12 October 2026 at 10:00 PDT (America/Los_Angeles, UTC−07:00) under the reopened GL-42 loan. I am accepting the recorder-only release, not restoring the lighting collection. This replaces the recorder pickup that I cancelled yesterday.

messages.subject: Glass Kite — GL-42 equipment loan
messages.body: I will send you the replacement insurance rider for the recorder-only GL-42 loan on 12 October 2026. It will list R8 and the sound-only insert, not LED kit L2. I have the insured address and the equipment valuation, so there is no form for you to complete.

messages.subject: Glass Kite — GL-42 equipment loan
messages.body:
Accounts asked why the first equipment valuation was higher than the new one. This is the approval attached to that original valuation:
---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Noor Iqbal <noor@focal-coop.example.test>
Date: 5 October 2026, 08:30 PDT
Subject: Glass Kite — GL-42 equipment loan
Release approved for GL-42: recorder R8 and LED lighting kit L2, collection 9 October 2026 at 17:00 PDT (America/Los_Angeles, UTC−07:00).
---------- End forwarded message ----------
The valuation row in the accounts export has not been replaced.

messages.subject: GL-42 damage deposit
messages.body: The payment dashboard labels the GL-42 deposit refund “sent” and gives transaction RF-240. Our bank download has no corresponding debit. The dashboard time is the batch submission time, not a confirmed credit to your card.

messages.subject: Glass Kite — GL-42 equipment loan
messages.body: I have accepted Sam’s GL-42 condition sheet; the notes and photographs are sufficient. The recorder R8 collection has not happened: R8 is still on my shelf. The signature in GL42-condition.pdf acknowledges its bench condition, not a transfer of custody.

messages.subject: Glass Kite — GL-42 equipment loan
messages.body: Sam’s LED lighting kit collection remains cancelled. The two panels are available in inventory, but the current GL-42 release contains only R8. The old approval forwarded by Accounts explains the old valuation; it does not add L2 to this release.

messages.subject: Glass Kite — GL-42 equipment loan
messages.body: The replacement insurance rider is drafted but has not been issued or sent to you. I corrected the coverage description from “night exterior” to “sound-only insert”; the policy number is unchanged. The 12 October issue date remains on the policy desk’s queue.

messages.subject: GL-42 damage deposit
messages.body: RF-240 now appears as “completed” in the payment vendor’s report and “rejected” in the bank export. I cannot determine whether your GL-42 damage deposit refund cleared or remains payable. There is no bank trace or signed instruction to carry the deposit onto the reopened recorder loan. Neither report establishes which system is wrong.
